title: Check database connection
code: RETURN 'Neo4j connection successful' AS status;

title: Create a customer (Aarav)
code:
MERGE (c:Customer {customerId: 101})
SET c.name = 'Aarav',
    c.email = 'aarav@example.com'
RETURN c;

title: Create a vendor (Spice House)
code:
MERGE (v:Vendor {vendorId: 201})
SET v.name = 'Spice House',
    v.cuisine = 'Indian',
    v.location = 'Chennai'
RETURN v;

title: Create food item and connect to vendor
code:
MATCH (v:Vendor {vendorId: 201})
MERGE (f:FoodItem {itemId: 301})
SET f.name = 'Paneer Biryani',
    f.price = 220,
    f.category = 'Main Course'
MERGE (f)-[:SOLD_BY]->(v)
RETURN f, v;

title: Create order and connect to customer
code:
MATCH (c:Customer {customerId: 101})
MERGE (o:Order {orderId: 401})
SET o.status = 'Placed',
    o.totalAmount = 220,
    o.orderDate = date()
MERGE (c)-[:PLACES]->(o)
RETURN c, o;

title: Connect order to food item
code:
MATCH (o:Order {orderId: 401}),
      (f:FoodItem {itemId: 301})
MERGE (o)-[r:CONTAINS]->(f)
SET r.quantity = 1
RETURN o, r, f;

title: Link sample review to Aarav and Spice House
code:
MATCH (c:Customer {customerId: 101}), (v:Vendor {vendorId: 201})
MERGE (r:Review {reviewId: 701})
SET r.rating = 5, r.comment = 'Authentic spices and very fast delivery!'
MERGE (c)-[:WROTE]->(r)
MERGE (r)-[:ABOUT]->(v)
RETURN c, r, v;

r.comment: Authentic spices and very fast delivery!

List food items under a chosen price (< 300)
code:
MATCH (f:FoodItem)
WHERE f.price < 300
RETURN f.name, f.price, f.category
ORDER BY f.price ASC;

title: Find orders for a specific customer (101)
Update order status
Count orders per customer
code:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACES]->(o:Order)
RETURN c.name AS customer,
       count(o) AS totalOrders
ORDER BY totalOrders DESC;

title: Find five most expensive food items
code:
MATCH (f:FoodItem)
RETURN f.name, f.price
ORDER BY f.price DESC
LIMIT 5;

title: Trace customer -> order -> food item -> vendor
code:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[:PLACES]->(o:Order)
      -[:CONTAINS]->(f:FoodItem)
      -[:SOLD_BY]->(v:Vendor)
RETURN c.name AS customer,
       o.orderId AS orderId,
       f.name AS foodItem,
       v.name AS vendor;

title: Count food items sold by each vendor
code:
MATCH (f:FoodItem)-[:SOLD_BY]->(v:Vendor)
RETURN v.name AS vendor,
       count(f) AS menuItems
ORDER BY menuItems DESC;

title: Basic vendor recommendations from order history
code:
MATCH (c:Customer {customerId: 101})
      -[:PLACES]->(:Order)
      -[:CONTAINS]->(:FoodItem)
      -[:SOLD_BY]->(v:Vendor)
RETURN v.name AS vendor,
       v.cuisine AS cuisine,
       count(*) AS matchingOrderPaths
ORDER BY matchingOrderPaths DESC;

title: Find vendors in the same cuisine as vendor 201
code:
MATCH (base:Vendor {vendorId: 201})
MATCH (other:Vendor)
WHERE other.cuisine = base.cuisine
  AND other.vendorId <> base.vendorId
RETURN other.name, other.cuisine, other.location;

title: Create/link a payment
code:
MATCH (o:Order {orderId: 401})
MERGE (p:Payment {paymentId: 501})
SET p.amount = 220,
    p.method = 'UPI',
    p.status = 'Paid'
MERGE (o)-[:HAS_PAYMENT]->(p)
RETURN o, p;

title: Create/link a delivery partner
code:
MATCH (o:Order {orderId: 401})
MERGE (d:DeliveryPartner {partnerId: 601})
SET d.name = 'Rohan',
    d.availability = 'Busy'
MERGE (o)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(d)
RETURN o, d;

title: Find orders and their delivery partners
code:
MATCH (o:Order)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(d:DeliveryPartner)
RETURN o.orderId, o.status, d.name AS deliveryPartner;

title: Find customer reviews and reviewed vendors
code:
MATCH (c:Customer)-[:WROTE]->(r:Review)-[:ABOUT]->(v:Vendor)
RETURN c.name AS customer,
       v.name AS vendor,
       r.rating AS rating,
       r.comment AS comment
ORDER BY rating DESC;
